title: 第19章 冲突第20章 强大的尤文图斯
content_zh:
第十九章 冲突
离开酒吧之后，迪甘又独自返回了训练场，一直到天黑才离开，他在贝尔加莫没什么朋友，说起来也就帕齐尼还聊得来，不过难得的假期，帕齐尼还要陪着他的女朋友，自然没时间来陪他这个好基友了。
把自己折腾的一身臭汗，迪甘才回了租住的公寓，然后美美的睡上一觉，第二天神清气爽的去参加球队的训练，外面关于他的新闻甚嚣尘上，但迪甘这个处在风暴中心的主角，却好像置身事外一样，随便你怎么样，老子不在乎。
迪甘的非暴力不合作，也让媒体记者暂时对他失去了兴趣，意大利什么都缺，就是不缺少足球明星的新闻，迪甘这么一个小嫩芽还不值得他们整天盯着不放，不过如果认为那些记者就这样放过了他的话，那可就大错特错了，他们鼻子一向比狗都要灵敏，只要迪甘的身上还在散发着肉味，他们就绝对不会罢手。
曼多利尼似乎也没受到影响，每天该怎么训练就怎么训练，倒是球队内部有些人对迪甘有了些看法，不过也只是私底下议论一番，他们都看得出来迪甘是曼多利尼的新宠，只要迪甘愿意，曼多利尼都能把他纳了妾，得罪迪甘，也就意味着得罪了曼多利尼，得罪了曼多利尼，就要像那个绍达蒂一样去预备队报道，他们可不想那样。
他们不想，可是有人却想，比如被迪甘抢了位置，又被曼多利尼发配去了预备队的绍达蒂。?? 球场狂徒19
他也是个天生的大嘴巴，当初因为被ac米兰抛弃，还曾一年到头的大放厥词，说会让ac米兰后悔，但是这么多年都过去了，ac米兰还是ac米兰，绍达蒂却成了老绍达蒂！
原本还想着要在亚特兰大发.春的，结果新赛季还没开始就被扔到了预备队，过起了暗无天日的日子，绍达蒂的心里自然气大了。
归根结蒂，他之所有有今天，全都是因为迪甘。
所以当一个小报记者找到他询问迪甘情况的时候，这位老兄毫不客气的就交代了，一些传闻再加上杜撰，最后经过艺术加工，就成了报纸上的一篇文字。
在绍达蒂的描述之中，迪甘就是一个彻头彻尾的伪君子，为了讨好曼多利尼，他今天送红包，明天送购物卡，还私底下不断诋毁和他位置冲突的球员，比如他老兄。
在更衣室里拉帮结派，打击那些外来户，布丹被他打掉牙，皮亚被他爆菊花，无恶不做，无法无天。
甚至还收取对方球队的好处费，在比赛的时候故意放水，和莱切的比赛，只是因为价钱没谈妥，迪甘才大发神威。
总之在这篇文章当中迪甘就是一个恶棍，流氓，同『性』恋，诈骗犯，赌徒，他活着都是社会的耻辱，就应该拉到梵蒂冈，让教皇用光明魔法，将他净化了了事。
结果这篇文章一问世，立刻在亚特兰大引起了轰动，那个撰写这篇文章的记者，差点儿被授予诺贝尔文学奖。
几乎整个贝尔加莫都知道了，唯独迪甘还蒙在鼓里，他这人不喜欢看报纸，虽然重生之后，他对意大利语熟悉的和汉语一样，但是看着那一大张纸的蝌蚪文，还是让他忍不住头疼。
第二轮比赛的前一天，迪甘和往常一样到了训练场，不知怎的，他总是感觉队友们看他的眼神有些怪异。
“詹保罗！”迪甘一把将要从他面前溜走的帕齐尼给拽了回来，“怎么回事？是我今天光着身子，还是我长得像et？”
帕齐尼干笑了一下，道：“罗德！我们只是有些紧张，对！比赛之前有些紧张，你知道的，我们明天要去都灵挑战尤文图斯，他们~~~~~~他们很强大，对！就是这样的！”
“放屁！”迪甘一句话就把帕齐尼接下来要说的给堵了回去，“要说别人紧张我相信，你小子会紧张，开什么玩笑！说！要是不说的话，我保证你今天训练的时候受伤！”

威胁！赤『裸』『裸』的威胁！
帕齐尼可不觉得迪甘是在开玩笑，就迪甘那脚力，要是把球踢在人的身上，轻则内伤，重则直接轰成渣渣，他可不敢拿自己的生命去赌，赶紧照实说了。
他一边说还在一边观察着迪甘的脸『色』，见迪甘的头发都要燃烧了，赶紧劝道：“罗德！没必要理会那个家伙，谁都知道他是个大嘴巴，一向口无遮拦的！罗德！别说是我告诉~~~~~你的！”
迪甘这会儿已经跑了出去，直奔预备队的训练场，亚特兰大可不像那些豪门，各个年龄段的球队都拥有属于自己的训练场，在贝尔加莫，亚特兰大的一线队和预备队的训练场，只隔着一道铁丝网。
迪甘突然杀气腾腾的出现在了预备队的训练场，手上还倒提着一个用来带球训练的假人，登时都吓坏了。?? 球场狂徒19
绍达蒂正阴沉着脸做着训练前的准备动作，他也很郁闷，原本应该在一线队冲锋陷阵的，可就是因为嘴巴没有上锁，结果得罪了曼多利尼，被充军发配了。
他现在还没注意到，他的大嘴巴又给他惹祸了。
“混蛋！受死吧！”
迪甘一声大吼，举着假人就砸了过去，绍达蒂的反应倒是不满，听到喊声就意识到了不妙，他昨天只顾着嘴巴痛快了，说得几乎高『潮』，却忘了还有现世报这回事，现在迪甘就来寻仇了。
他一个就地十八滚，躲过了砸来的假人，连滚带爬的站起来，撒腿就跑，可是他的速度哪能比得上迪甘，还没跑出去一百米就被迪甘给追上了。
欧耶！青春！
一个大飞腿，差点把绍达蒂的老腰都踹折了，接着扑上去就是一阵拳打脚踢，一旁的预备队教练和球员直接都看傻了，他们都是血气方刚的年轻人，平日里也和人动过拳头，可就他们那王八拳哪比得上迪甘现在这么爆裂。
左勾拳，右钩拳，通天炮，金鸡『乱』点头，照着绍达蒂的身上一通招呼。
等曼多利尼等人接到消息过来的时候，迪甘刷经验刷的几乎都要满值了，绍达蒂也被彻彻底底的重新塑了型。
曼多利尼看着几乎都要晕倒了，明天可就是和尤文图斯的比赛了，今天却出了这样的事。
帕齐尼等人也被吓得够呛，迪甘现在的模样分明就是要杀人，反应过来之后，赶紧上前，五六个人一起把迪甘从绍达蒂的身上拉了下来，这会儿再去看贱嘴绍达蒂，已经彻底歇菜了。
曼多利尼倒是盼着自己现在就晕过去才好，最好醒过来的时候，发现这一切都只是个噩梦，什么都没发生，可问题是他的心里也是气大了，居然越来越精神。
他也应该庆幸，今天是比赛开始的前一天，基本上每到了这个时候，球队都是要进行封闭训练的，没有球『迷』围观，至少也能防止这件事被无限的放大。
“告诉所有人，今天的事绝对不能外传！”
助理教练蒙多尼科点头道：“放心吧，我知道怎么处理，但是安德烈，你也要做好准备，这件事隐瞒不了太长的时间，就算是能堵住所有人的嘴，但是绍达蒂呢！？”

曼多利尼道：“我当然知道，而且我也没打算隐瞒，你这就去通知一下《贝尔加莫体育报》的记者罗达尼尼先生，把这件事告诉他，就说迪甘和绍达蒂在训练的时候发生了冲突。”
蒙多尼科闻言，眼睛顿时一亮，曼多利尼这么处理，显然是最好的，提前将这件事告诉媒体，占据理论的最高峰，到时候该怎么处理，那就是亚特兰大队内的事情了。
当然也要防止绍达蒂将这件事引入司法程序，要是那样的话可就麻烦了。
等到第二天，亚特兰大队赶赴都灵的时候，这件事已经被闹的满城风雨，无数记者将电话打到了球队新闻官那里，询问球队将会对迪甘作出怎样的惩罚，对此新闻官给出的回答是一一这件事我们还在调查当中。
content_en:
Chapter 19 Conflict
After leaving the bar, Deegan returned to the training ground alone and didn't leave until dark. He didn't have many friends in Bergamo. Speaking of which, Pazzini was the only one he could talk to. However, during this rare holiday, Pazzini had to accompany his girlfriend, so naturally he didn't have time to spend time with his good friend.
After sweating all over, Deegan returned to his rented apartment, had a good sleep, and went to the team's training refreshed the next day. There was a lot of news about him outside, but Deegan, the protagonist at the center of the storm, seemed to be aloof. Whatever you do, I don't care.
Deegan's non-violent non-cooperation also caused the media reporters to temporarily lose interest in him. Italy lacks everything except news about football stars. A young bud like Deegan is not worthy of their attention all day long. However, if you think that the reporters will just let him go, it is a big mistake. Their noses have always been more sensitive than dogs. As long as Deegan's body still smells of meat, they will never stop.
Mandolini didn't seem to be affected, and he trained as he should every day. However, some people in the team had some opinions about Deegan, but they only discussed it privately. They all could see that Deegan was Mandolini's new favorite. As long as Deegan was willing, Mandolini could take him as his concubine. Offending Deegan meant offending Mandolini. If Mandolini was offended, he would have to go to the reserve team to report like that Saudati. They didn't want that.
They don't want to, but some people do, such as Saudati, who was robbed of his position by Deegan and sent to the reserve team by Mandolini. ?? Stadium Outlaws 19
He is also a natural loudmouth. Because he was abandoned by AC Milan, he used to talk nonsense all year round, saying that AC Milan would regret it. But after so many years, AC Milan is still AC Milan, and Saudati has become the old Saudati!
Originally, he was thinking of making a splash in Atlanta, but as a result, he was thrown to the reserve team before the new season started, and lived a life of darkness. Naturally, Saudati felt very angry.
Ultimately, everything he is today is because of Deegan.
So when a tabloid reporter came to him to ask about Deegan's situation, the man unceremoniously confessed that some rumors were fabricated, and finally, through artistic processing, became a piece of text in the newspaper.
In Saudati's description, Deegan is a complete hypocrite. In order to please Mandolini, he will send red envelopes today and shopping cards tomorrow, and privately continue to slander players who conflict with his position, such as his brother.
He formed gangs in the locker room and attacked outsiders. Boudin had his teeth knocked out by him, and Pia had his anus fucked by him. He did all kinds of evil and lawlessness.
He even charged benefits from the opposing team and deliberately let off steam during the game. In the game with Lecce, Deegan only showed off his power because the price could not be negotiated.
In short, in this article Deegan is a villain, a gangster, a homosexual, a fraudster, and a gambler. He is a shame to society as long as he lives. He should be taken to the Vatican and let the Pope use light magic to purify him.
As a result, as soon as this article came out, it immediately caused a sensation in Atlanta. The reporter who wrote this article was almost awarded the Nobel Prize for Literature.
Almost everyone in Bergamo knew about it, but Deegan was still in the dark. He didn't like reading newspapers. Although after his rebirth, he was as familiar with Italian as Chinese, but looking at the tadpole text on that large piece of paper still gave him a headache.
The day before the second round of the game, Deegan arrived at the training ground as usual. Somehow, he always felt that his teammates looked at him strangely.
"Giampaolo!" Deegan grabbed Pazzini who was about to slip away from him.came back, "What's going on? Am I naked today, or do I look like et?"
Pazzini laughed dryly and said: "Rod! We are just a little nervous, yes! We were a little nervous before the game. You know, we are going to Turin to challenge Juventus tomorrow. They~~~~~~ They are very strong, yes! That's it!"
"Fart!" Deegan blocked what Pazzini was about to say with one sentence. "If others are nervous, I believe you will be nervous. What a joke! Say it! If you don't say it, I guarantee you will get injured during training today!"
Threat! A naked threat!
Pazzini didn't think Deegan was joking. With Deegan's foot power, if he kicked the ball on someone, he would be injured internally, or directly blown into pieces. He didn't dare to risk his life, so he quickly told the truth.
While he was talking, he was still observing Deegan's face. Seeing that Deegan's hair was about to burn, he quickly advised: "Rhode! There is no need to pay attention to that guy. Everyone knows that he is a big mouth and always speaks freely! Rhodes! Don't say I told you~~~~~!"
Deegan had already run out and went straight to the reserve team's training ground. Unlike those wealthy clubs, Atlanta's teams of all ages have their own training ground. In Bergamo, Atlanta's first team and reserve team's training ground are only separated by a barbed wire fence.
Deegan suddenly appeared at the reserve team's training ground with a murderous look, holding a dummy used for dribbling training upside down in his hand, and everyone was immediately frightened. ?? Stadium Outlaws 19
Saudati was making preparations before training with a sullen face. He was also very depressed. He was supposed to charge in the first team, but because his mouth was not locked, he offended Mandolini and was sent to the army.
He hadn't noticed yet, but his big mouth had gotten him into trouble again.
"Asshole! Die!"
Deegan yelled and smashed the dummy at it. Saudati's reaction was dissatisfied. He realized something was wrong when he heard the shout. Yesterday, he only cared about having fun with his mouth. He almost climaxed while talking, but he forgot that there is such a thing as retribution. Now Deegan is here to seek revenge.
He rolled on the spot, dodged the dummy that was thrown at him, stood up and ran away, but his speed could not compare with Deegan, and he was caught up by Deegan before he could run a hundred meters.
Oh yeah! youth!
A big flying kick almost broke Saudati's waist, and then he rushed forward with a flurry of punches and kicks. The reserve team coaches and players on the side were dumbfounded. They were all vigorous young people, and they usually used fists with others, but their bastard punches were not as explosive as Deegan's now.
Left hook, right hook, Sky Cannon, Golden Rooster nodded randomly, and said hello to Saudati.
By the time Mandolini and others received the news, Degan had almost reached full experience points, and Saudati had been completely reshaped.
Mandolini almost fainted when he saw it. Tomorrow was the game against Juventus, but something like this happened today.
Pazzini and others were also frightened. Deegan clearly wanted to kill someone. After reacting, they hurried forward and five or six people pulled Degan off Saudati's body. At this time, they went to see the bitchy Saudati, who had completely stopped.
Mandolini was really looking forward to fainting now. It would be better if he woke up and found that everything was just a nightmare and nothing happened. But the problem was that he was also angry and became more and more energetic.
He should also be thankful that today is the day before the game starts. Basically, at this time, the team has to conduct closed training. There are no fans to watch, which at least can prevent this matter from being infinitely magnified.
"Tell theSomeone, today’s matter must not be spread outside! "
Assistant coach Mondonico nodded and said: "Don't worry, I know how to deal with it, but Andre, you have to be prepared. This matter can't be hidden for too long. Even if you can block everyone's mouths, what about Saudati! ? "
Mandolini said: "Of course I know, and I have no intention of hiding it. You should inform Mr. Rodanini, the reporter of "Bergamo Sport", and tell him about the incident. Just say that there was a conflict between Deegan and Saudati during training. "
Mondonico's eyes suddenly lit up when he heard this. Mandolini's handling of this matter was obviously the best. He told the media about the matter in advance and occupied the highest theoretical peak. How to deal with it at that time was a matter within the Atlanta team.
Of course, we must also prevent Saudati from introducing this matter into judicial proceedings. If that happens, it will be troublesome.
By the next day, when the Atlanta team rushed to Turin, the incident had already become a rage. Countless reporters called the team's press officer and asked what kind of punishment the team would impose on Deegan. The answer given by the press officer was - we are still investigating this matter.
